text: In plural predication, a predicate that is true of some things together and of no one of them individually — like 'weigh a ton' said of the rocks — is called a ___ predicate.
explanation: A collective (non-distributive) predicate applies to the objects jointly, unlike a distributive predicate that applies to each one individually. 'The rocks weigh a ton' is collective — no single rock weighs a ton.
